items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Danny Barker, Buck Clayton, Andy Kirk, Clark Terry.

ctx.x: All them before me. And who the next year?
Danny Barker, Buck Clayton, Andy Kirk, Clark Terry.
You see, I don't know how I got mine so quick in 1989 with all those people, but I’m glad I got it though.
